title: Carjacking Suspect Shot After Vape Pen Thought To Be Knife
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Las Vegas, Nevada — On November 23, 2025, at approximately 12:26 p.m., LVMPD officers responded to a carjacking in progress at an apartment complex in the 5100 block of Indian River Drive. The victim stated that the suspect, identified as 38-year-old Wade David Griffith, was armed with a knife and had threatened him. As officers arrived, they encountered Griffith near the entrance of the complex. Officers issued verbal commands and attempted to take him into custody. At some point, a physical altercation between Griffith and two officers occurred. During the fight, Griffith produced what officers believed to be a knife, causing an officer to discharge his firearm. 

Griffith was struck by gunfire and taken into custody. Medical personnel transported Griffith to a nearby hospital in stable condition. Throughout the course of the investigation, Metro police learned that Griffith was holding a vape pen with a closed fist during the struggle. Police believe he was holding a vape pen while he made the “swiping” motion toward the officers. Inside Griffith’s backpack, police found a large, fixed-blade knife in a sheath as well as a second empty sheath for a large knife. However, at the time of the shooting, police believe he was holding the vape pen. Griffith was arrested on two counts of robbery with the use of a deadly weapon, two counts of battery with the use of a deadly weapon against an officer, and two counts of resisting a public officer with the use of a deadly weapon.
